metadata.description: Noesis AI skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: mentor-polling
plugins.description: Paces mentor_get_run polls (45 s per run) and compacts their output before Claude reads it, plus a skill on how to poll and read Mentor runs.

plugins.name: token-usage
plugins.description: Counts Claude Code token usage per model and session into .claude/hooks/token-stats.json, plus a skill that reports it.
